n1.speaker: momo
n1.text: I can feel them before they open. Gates. It's why I move so much.

n2.speaker: momo
n2.text: I don't know why I'm like this. I just know it's not... normal.

choices.text: "Do you think it's connected to why the gates started?"
"Whatever it is, it doesn't change anything for me."

n3_ask.speaker: momo
n3_ask.text: ...Maybe. I've never said that thought out loud before.

n3_comfort.speaker: momo
n3_comfort.text: ...Thank you. I needed to hear that.
